verdict.rationale: Netlify documents its own event-triggered background automation: it auto-deploys on every push and builds a preview for every PR. It also lets users prompt AI agents from the dashboard to fix and ship code, though that is a one-off action rather than a configured recurring automation. The REST API and serverless functions are developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: user-defined automation rules or workflows, recurring/scheduled background jobs, autonomous agent triggers (as opposed to one-off prompts), and any independent corroboration of background agent execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Auto-deploy on every push. Every PR gets a preview URL.
